note: Literature confirms intellectual disability/developmental delay is universal across reported TRA2B cases while seizures/infantile spasms are frequent but present in a subset.

evidence.text: All 12 individuals with TRA2B variants exhibited intellectual disability and/or developmental delay, while infantile spasms and seizures occurred frequently but not in all individuals.

source.title: Clustered variants in the 5′ coding region of TRA2B cause a distinctive neurodevelopmental syndrome
source.quote: All affected individuals presented intellectual disability and/or developmental delay, frequently associated with infantile spasms, microcephaly, brain anomalies, autism spectrum disorder, feeding difficulties, and short stature.
